requirements.name: The page offers a route back to Overview

requirements.name: A notification can hold at most ten accompanying documents

scenarios.name: A tenth document is accepted and an eleventh is rejected

tests.test: accepts a tenth document and rejects an eleventh with the maximum-documents error
tests.notes: ten Safe rows, eleventh error link, list stays at ten

tests.test: rejects another upload after the maximum document capacity is reached
tests.notes: uploads ten then eleventh; error links to #documents-added and preserves the typed reference

requirements.name: Each accompanying document has a maximum file size

scenarios.name: A file at exactly the size limit is accepted, one byte over is rejected

tests.test: accepts a 10 MB PDF and rejects the same real file at one byte over

scenarios.name: Picking a grossly oversize file is refused before any document is added

tests.test: refuses an oversize file pick without adding a document
file validation: client-side oversize error focuses the summary and retains metadata
tests.notes: client oversize path with metadata retained — does not assert the empty-list clause (page already had metadata filled, no prior docs)

scenarios.name: An oversize file submitted without the browser check running is still refused

tests.test: file validation: server rejects an oversize multipart payload
tests.notes: bypasses client check via form.submit(); focuses file field; empty state remains

requirements.name: Only supported file types can be uploaded

scenarios.name: An unsupported file type is rejected

tests.test: file validation: unsupported type links to and focuses the upload while preserving metadata
tests.notes: focus + preserved reference/date — does not re-assert empty-state copy (no document row is added either)

requirements.name: The reference and date of issue are each required, and individually validated

tests.test: reference validation: empty value links to and focuses the preserved field

scenarios.name: A reference over the maximum length links to and focuses the reference field, preserving the value

tests.test: reference validation: over 58 characters links to and focuses the preserved value

scenarios.name: An empty date of issue links to and focuses the date field, preserving the reference

tests.test: date validation: empty value links to and focuses the preserved field

scenarios.name: An impossible date links to and focuses the date field, preserving what was typed

tests.test: date validation: impossible date links to and focuses the preserved value

scenarios.name: No file chosen links to and focuses the file field, preserving the reference and date

tests.test: file validation: no file links to and focuses the upload while preserving metadata

requirements.name: Every uploaded document is virus-scanned before it can be used

scenarios.name: A clean upload becomes Safe and viewable

tests.test: clean upload: shows Checking with no view link, then Safe with a view link
uploads through the configured stub and renders the saved row
tests.notes: Checking then Safe on the row — does not assert view-link absence while Checking

tests.test: blocks continue while checking, then renders Safe and allows the journey to continue
tests.notes: Checking then Safe; continue gate — view-link transition covered better by E2E

scenarios.name: An infected upload is flagged and blocked

tests.test: infected upload: accepted with Checking, then Virus found with error summary and no view link
renders Virus found and its per-file error until the document is removed
tests.notes: Checking → Virus found, error, zero view links

requirements.name: The user cannot continue while a document is still being scanned or is infected

scenarios.name: Continuing is blocked while a scan is still checking

tests.test: blocks continue while checking, then renders Safe and allows the journey to continue
tests.notes: cannotContinue error while Checking; after Safe, Continue reaches Overview

scenarios.name: Continuing is blocked while an infected document remains

tests.test: renders Virus found and its per-file error until the document is removed
tests.notes: Continue re-shows virus error; after remove, Continue reaches Overview

requirements.name: Each document's scan status updates independently, and completion is announced

scenarios.name: One document settles while another stays pending

tests.test: updates one settled row in place, announces it and leaves a still-pending row alone
tests.notes: Safe + view link + announcer; stuck row still Checking

requirements.name: Scan progress can be followed without client-side JavaScript

scenarios.name: A manual refresh reflects scan progress until the file is Safe

tests.test: the refresh fallback reflects scan progress without client JavaScript
tests.notes: javaScriptEnabled: false; refresh until Safe; refresh gone; view link present

requirements.name: An uploaded document can be viewed and removed

tests.notes: content-type PDF, nosniff, body starts with %PDF- — not a full byte-for-byte compare against the upload buffer

scenarios.name: Removing a document takes it off the notification

tests.test: removes a saved document and restores the empty state

requirements.name: An attached document keeps its exact file and survives a reload

scenarios.name: An uploaded document is kept intact and still listed after a reload
